svg.aria-label: Your research desk: five source cards on a wooden desk, beside a cup of coffee, a pen and a sticky note with your question: Is Sydney good for students? Why? Smith and Anderson 2024, a survey: Sydney is in the top 5% of study cities; it is safe with a good climate and culture; Melbourne has 140 rainy days a year. Jones 2024, an opinion: the cost of living is too high for international students; study in a rural town instead. Thompson 2023, research: many students cannot find accommodation within their budget. Schwartz 2022, an article: Melbourne’s beaches are polluted with poor conditions for surfers. Phelps 2023, a report: Melbourne suits people who like cooler weather and has more cultural activities.

g.text: The cost of living is too high
Study in a rural town instead?
